{{Top|fga}} {{Update|[[Visitor's Day (episode)|Visitor's Day]], [[Big Brother's Bounty]], [[Best Bounty Buddies]]}} {{Character |type= |image=[[File:Weebo_YJA_S1E5.png]] |name=Weebo |homeworld=[[Tenoo]]{{YJA|The Jellyfruit Pursuit}} |birth= |death= |species=[[Rodian]] |gender=[[Gender|Female]] |pronouns=She/her |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|White]] |feathers= |eyes=Black |skin=Green |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=[[Weebo's farm]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|To the Jellyfruit Festival heroes!|Weebo offers a toast to Durango and the Jedi|}} '''Weebo''' was a [[Rodian]] [[Gender|female]] [[farmer]] who grew [[jellyfruit]] on the [[planet]] [[Tenoo]]. Around [[233 BBY]], her jellyfruit harvest was [[Thief|stolen]] by [[Taborr's gang|pirates]] just before the [[fruit]] was to be used for the [[Jellyfruit Festival]]. She informed the owner of the [[restaurant]] [[Hap's Sap Tap]], [[Hap]], of the ordeal, who was with [[pilot]] [[Nash Durango]] and three [[Jedi Initiate|Jedi younglings]]. Deducing who and where the [[pirate]]s were based on Weebo's and her [[Weebo's grandson|grandson's]] description, the [[Jedi]] were able to bring the jellyfruit back, saving the festival. ==Biography== {{Quote|Hey, Weebo. How's tonight's jellyfruit shipment coming?''"
"''It ain't coming, Hap. It's going. A group of pirates just left with it.|Hap and Weebo|}} Weebo was an elderly [[Rodian]] [[Gender|female]] [[jellyfruit]] [[farmer]] who lived on the [[planet]] [[Tenoo]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. She had a [[Weebo's farm|farm]] on which she grew [[jellyfruit tree]]s. Around [[233 BBY]],{{YJADate|105A}} she and her [[Weebo's grandson|grandson]] had just finished picking and loading the last jellyfruit in preparation for the [[City|town]] of [[Kublop Springs]]' [[Jellyfruit Festival]] when the [[pirate]] [[Cyrus Vuundir|Taborr Val Dorn]] arrived. Lowering himself from his [[Iron Talon|starship]], he affixed a clamp to the crate of jellyfruit and taunted the Rodians about him [[Thief|stealing]] the delicacies. As Weebo protectively stepped in front of her grandson, Taborr rode on the crate while it rose back up to the ship, laughing and boasting about the profits he would make. Weebo gave her grandson a hug and lamented that Kublop Springs would not be able to observe the Jellyfruit Festival. [[File:WeeboSad-TJP.png|thumb|left|270px|Weebo (left) consoles her grandson.]] The farmer then called [[Hap]], proprietor of the [[Restaurant|eatery]] [[Hap's Sap Tap]] where the festival was to take place, to inform him of the unpleasent news. Hap and several [[Youngling|kids]] helping him—the [[pilot]] [[Nash Durango]] and [[Jedi Initiate|Jedi younglings]] [[Kai Brightstar]], [[Lys Solay]], and [[Nubs]]—reacted with woe. Solay inquired as to the [[Taborr's gang|pirates']] appearance, which Weebo gave—matching that of Val Dorn, whom the Jedi and Durango had fought before. Durango promised that she and the younglings would get the [[fruit]] back, of which Hap was skeptical as they did not know where the pirates had gone. Weebo's grandson then chimed in, adding that Val Dorn had mentioned their intention to sell the stolen goods to other pirates. Durango thus concluded that he would be at the planet [[Yarrum]], so she and the Jedi left for the world in Durango's starship, the ''[[Crimson Firehawk]]''. Their mission was successful: they brought back the jellyfruit and allowed the merrymaking to go on. Weebo [[Toast (ritual)|toasted]] a fruit to the heroes of the festival. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|That pirate took all the fruit, Grandma.''"
"''Oh, honey, I know.|Weebo's grandson and Weebo|}} When Weebo lost all of her jellyfruit, she hugged her grandson comfortingly, calling him "honey," but was herself also quite distraught. She was ecstatic at the fruits' return. The Rodian had [[Color|green]] skin, black [[eye]]s, and tied-up white [[hair]]. ==Equipment== Weebo donned a white [[Clothing|shirt]] with a blue garment over it as well as dark pants. ==Behind the scenes== Weebo first appeared in "[[The Jellyfruit Pursuit]]," the first part of the fifth episode of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures]]'', where she was voiced by [[Lainie Kazan]]. The episode was released on [[May 4]], [[2023]].{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-may-2023|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in May 2023}} ==Appearances== *{{YJA|The Jellyfruit Pursuit}} {{1st}} *''[[Young Jedi Adventures: The Jellyfruit Pursuit]]'' *{{YJA|Visitor's Day (episode)}} *{{YJA|Big Brother's Bounty}} *{{YJA|Best Bounty Buddies}} {{Mo}} *{{YJA|Making Friends}} ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Weebo}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ja=ウィーボ |nl=Weebo }} [[Category:Farmers]] [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Individuals with she/her pronouns]] [[Category:Rodians]] [[Category:Tenooans]]
